description.narrative: Benin - Access To Markets Projects - Waterside Improvements Activity: MCC Funding will support the following waterside improvements: (i) Front-end engineering and design for major civil and mechanical facilities, works and dredging and dredged material disposal, (ii) New South wharf construction of approximately 595 meters of berth space for new terminal operations, and mitigating measures associated with dredging and dredged material disposal, (iii) Sedimentation control scheme that permits reduction of the sedimentation at the Port entrance and does not adversely impact coastal erosion, (iv) Acquisition of additional tug boat with necessary pilot training.
